claims.statement: Inventory Control reports allocation totals reconcile and nothing looks wrong on their side
claims.corroboration: Single non-authoritative source; needs tier-1 corroboration

capability_gaps.reason: m8_e09 documents observability gap: dashboards cannot show relationship between booked pickup and carrier's own confirmation

next_action.rationale: The stuck orders are all flagged as split-reservation exceptions, suggesting inventory allocation/count issues at east node. Authoritative inventory audit will discriminate between a dock capacity problem, a count drift issue, or a rule-induced over-reservation. This is the highest-information diagnostic to test the allocation rule v18 hypothesis.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Will reveal if east-node inventory counts match what the allocation rule expects, or if there is drift/over-reservation causing the split-exception pattern
